description: The six digits both screens show while pairing: HMAC-SHA256 with the token as key over the device id, both as UTF-8; the first four bytes of the digest as a big-endian unsigned integer, modulo 1000000, left-padded with zeros to six digits. Shared with the mobile client.

cases.name: a first byte with its top bit set stays unsigned

byHand.arithmetic: printf 'dev-phone' | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac test-token starts 877d42e8; as an unsigned integer 2273133288; its last six digits.

cases.name: a first byte with its top bit clear

byHand.arithmetic: printf 'phone-1' | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac tok-b starts 7c5e525c; as an unsigned integer 2086556252; its last six digits.

cases.name: a small remainder keeps its leading zeros

byHand.arithmetic: printf 'phone-36' | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac tok-zero starts e2426c60; as an unsigned integer 3796003936; its last six digits.

cases.name: a device id is hashed as UTF-8

byHand.arithmetic: printf 'm\xc3\xb3vil-\xc3\xb1' | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac tok-a starts c5fd700c; as an unsigned integer 3321720844; its last six digits.
